upgrades.title: Strict manual updates
upgrades.summary: The app stays on the installed version until you explicitly choose Update.

upgrades.title: Safer versioned caches
upgrades.summary: Each release uses its own offline cache so an unopened update cannot replace the active app.

upgrades.title: Backup & Update flow
upgrades.summary: A staged circular progress flow protects attendance records before installation.

upgrades.title: Update without backup
upgrades.summary: You can install an available release directly when a fresh backup is not needed.

upgrades.title: Dynamic release notes
upgrades.summary: What’s New content now follows the installed or available release automatically.

upgrades.title: Improved recovery safeguards
upgrades.summary: Pending restore markers and welcome-screen recovery continue to protect user data.

fixes.title: Activation ordering
fixes.summary: The active-version marker is written only after the approved worker controls the reloaded page.

fixes.title: Closed-app behavior
fixes.summary: Closing with a waiting worker keeps the previous version active and shows the update prompt again.

fixes.title: No same-version upgrades
fixes.summary: An unchanged version no longer triggers a silent build refresh.

fixes.title: Notification exclusions
fixes.summary: Off and Completed classes remain excluded from inappropriate reminders.

fixes.title: Upcoming class filters
fixes.summary: Upcoming views continue to omit completed and excluded class states correctly.

fixes.title: Progress feedback
fixes.summary: Backup, download, installation, and completion stages retain realistic non-instant progress.
